ddl.value:
("account_ref" IS NULL) = ("account_label" IS NULL)
        AND ("account_label" IS NULL OR char_length("account_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 120)
ddl.name: connection_account

ddl.value: "name" IS NULL OR (char_length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND "name" = btrim("name"))
ddl.name: connection_sign_in_name

ddl.value:
("connection_id" IS NULL) <> ("name" IS NULL)
        AND ("connection_id" IS NULL) = ("connection_revision" IS NULL)
ddl.name: connection_sign_in_target

ddl.value: ("agent_id" is not null and "version_number" is not null and "person_id" is null) or ("agent_id" is null and "version_number" is null and "person_id" is not null)
ddl.name: connector_write_speaker

ddl.value: "kind" <> 'AUTOMATION_DONE' or ("conversation_id" is not null and "failure_code" is null)
ddl.name: notification_done

ddl.value: "kind" <> 'AUTOMATION_FAILED' or ("failure_code" is not null and "failure_code" in ('MODEL_NO_ACCOUNT', 'MODEL_CALL_FAILED', 'MODEL_REFUSED', 'MODEL_ANSWER_CUT', 'MACHINE_UNAVAILABLE', 'MACHINE_LOST', 'HUB_UPDATED', 'INTERNAL_UNEXPECTED', 'DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE', 'INTERRUPTED', 'SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_FAILED'))
ddl.name: notification_failed

ddl.value: "kind" <> 'AUTOMATION_PAUSED' or ("conversation_id" is null and "failure_code" is null)
ddl.name: notification_paused
